//ClientIds: The client IDs this API pins in its authorization rules. Each must equal the same key under ClientIds in src/IDP/appsettings.json (where the IDP registers the client); a missing one stops the start-up.
//Mfa: Step-up: officer decisions need a sign-in with the authenticator code while true. Keep it equal to the IDP's Mfa:Enabled.

Mfa.//StepUpMaxAgeMinutes: While MFA is on, a decision needs a sign-in with the authenticator code at most this many minutes old (1-60).

//ConnectionStrings: PaymentsDbConnection holds a password, so it is NOT in this file (which goes into the container image): Development reads it from appsettings.Development.json, everywhere else from the environment (ConnectionStrings__PaymentsDbConnection) or a secret store. Missing = the API refuses to start.

Payments.//ApprovalLimits: What a payments officer may approve, by clearance level: an amount, or "Unlimited" (blank or missing stops the start-up); below the lowest level nothing.
Payments.//Outbox: The relay's publish attempts per message before it is PARKED (operations resend it on the Processing Monitor); the n-th attempt after BaseDelaySeconds x 2^(n-1).

Saga.//UnconfirmedAlertMinutes: A payment the network has not confirmed for this long is an operations alert (health, Processing Monitor), and only then may two people resolve it by hand.

PaymentNetwork.//PermittedHosts: Outside Development: the only hosts BaseUrl may name (https, not an internal address). Empty = the API refuses to start outside Development.
